howItWorks.label: Getting Started
howItWorks.title: Up and Running in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No complicated setup. Just download, install, and launch.

steps.title: Download
steps.description: Download only from sefinek.net or stella.sefinek.net. Avoid GameBanana and NexusMods, as infected forks have been found there.

steps.title: Install
steps.description: Run the InnoSetup installer. It takes about 20 seconds, and missing dependencies are downloaded automatically. Do not install it in the game folder.

steps.title: Configure
steps.description: Launch Stella Mod Launcher.exe. On first run, select the features you want to use (ReShade, FPS Unlocker, 3DMigoto) and click Start Game.

steps.title: Play
steps.description: Press the Home key in-game to open the ReShade overlay and fine-tune shaders to your taste.

items.question: Is Stella Mod safe to use?
items.answer: Yes, completely. Stella Mod does not modify any original game files. It runs on a separate layer, improving visuals and performance without touching core game data. Over 30,000 players use it safely.

items.question: Can I play online with Stella Mod?
items.answer: Yes. The software operates safely and does not modify game files, so online play is fully supported.

items.question: Is Genshin Stella Mod affiliated with HoYoverse?
items.answer: No. Stella Mod is an independent project and is not affiliated with miHoYo, COGNOSPHERE, or HoYoverse in any way. All game trademarks belong to their respective owners.

items.question: Can I record videos and post them online?
items.answer: Yes! You can record gameplay using Genshin Stella Mod and publish it on YouTube or any platform you choose.

items.question: Can I create my own ReShade presets?
items.answer: Absolutely. Press the Home key in-game to open the ReShade overlay and customize effects to your liking. You can also share your presets with the community via a GitHub Pull Request.

items.question: Where can I get support?
items.answer: You can contact us through Sefinek Patron Center by creating a ticket at patrons.sefinek.net (recommended), by messaging sefinek directly on Discord, or by emailing contact@sefinek.net for business inquiries. You can write in Polish or English.

items.question: Why is Stella Mod not open-source?
items.answer: Keeping the source code closed protects authentication tokens, prevents infected forks (which happened in the past on GameBanana), and ensures all users download the original, verified version from the official source.
